source: ClientCare Social row 15: You probably do not need 20% down to buy a home.
hookSub: One of the most persistent myths in home buying

slides.small: FHA can start at 3.5% down. Some conventional loans start at 3%.

slides.big: VA and USDA can be zero down
slides.small: For eligible veterans, service members and buyers in eligible areas.

slides.big: Less than 20% usually means mortgage insurance
slides.small: It is part of the monthly payment. On conventional loans it can be removed later.

slides.big: Your numbers beat a rule of thumb
slides.small: The right option depends on your income, credit, the property and your goals.

comment: Did you believe this myth? Yes or no?
